item.title: Modernizing Legacy Microservices: The Power of Proxy Sidecars
item.description:
Modernizing Legacy Microservices: The Power of Proxy Sidecars

How do you monitor a legacy app without changing its code? You use a sidecar proxy.

Over the weekend, I built a local throwaway lab to test this. Here is how I set up the base environment and added HAProxy, Caddy, and Envoy to get full HTTP metrics and distributed tracing.

The Base Environment: Multipass & K3s

Before injecting sidecars, I needed a clean, reproducible infrastructure. I used Multipass to spin up an Ubuntu VM on my local machine and deployed a lightweight Kubernetes cluster using K3s.
